features.name: Blockchain-Based Immutable Audit Trails
features.description: Log all critical data events to blockchain for immutable audit trails, log admin access to personal data, log data modifications with old/new values, log data subject rights requests, log consent changes, cryptographically hash events, provide searchable interface, generate compliance reports
features.stakeholderBenefit: Immutable, tamper-proof record of all data access and modifications proves compliance during audits

features.name: Document Verification
features.description: Require government-issued photo ID upload, verify document authenticity using automated services, check for forgery indicators, extract and validate information, verify documents are not expired, cross-reference with registration data, flag discrepancies for manual review
features.stakeholderBenefit: Platform can verify user identity documents to ensure renters are who they claim to be

features.name: Biometric Facial Verification
features.description: Require selfie submission for facial verification, compare selfie to ID photo using facial recognition, calculate similarity score with minimum threshold (95% confidence), flag low-confidence matches for manual review, implement liveness detection, protect biometric data with encryption
features.stakeholderBenefit: Platform can verify that the person renting matches their identity document, preventing identity theft

features.name: Liveness Detection
features.description: Implement passive liveness detection analyzing micro-reflections and texture patterns, detect presentation attacks (photos, videos, masks, deepfakes), analyze multiple frames for signs of life, use AI models to distinguish live humans from spoofing, require active liveness checks for high-risk transactions
features.stakeholderBenefit: Platform can detect when someone is using a photo or video instead of live face, preventing spoofing attacks

features.name: Payment Verification
features.description: Verify payment method belongs to user through cardholder name matching, require CVV/CVC verification, implement 3D Secure authentication, verify billing address (AVS), flag mismatches for additional verification, implement velocity checks, detect stolen cards, integrate with fraud detection services
features.stakeholderBenefit: Platform can verify payment methods to prevent payment fraud and chargebacks

features.name: Booking Pattern Analysis
features.description: Monitor for velocity anomalies (multiple bookings in short time), detect unusual booking patterns, flag mismatched information, detect disposable email/temporary phone numbers, monitor bookings followed by cancellations, detect high-value vehicle bookings by new users, flag unusual rental periods
features.stakeholderBenefit: Platform can detect suspicious booking patterns to prevent fraudulent reservations

features.name: Device and Location Intelligence
features.description: Implement device fingerprinting to identify unique devices, detect multiple accounts from same device, detect single account from multiple devices in impossible timeframes, verify user location through IP geolocation, flag high-risk countries, detect VPNs/proxies/Tor, verify booking location matches typical patterns
features.stakeholderBenefit: Platform can analyze device and location data to detect fraudulent access patterns

features.name: Blockchain Immutable Event Logging
features.description: Log all critical events to blockchain for tamper-proof audit trails, write pickup/return events to blockchain, write damage reports to blockchain, write maintenance events to blockchain, cryptographically hash each event, create unbreakable chain of custody, provide mathematically provable audit trails
features.stakeholderBenefit: Platform has immutable record of all critical events for fraud investigations and legal disputes

features.name: PCI DSS - Secure Network Architecture
features.description: Install and maintain firewall configurations, do not use vendor-supplied defaults, segment payment systems from other networks, restrict traffic to necessary only, implement network intrusion detection/prevention, review firewall configurations every six months, document network connections
features.stakeholderBenefit: Network security controls protect payment data and prevent unauthorized access to cardholder data

features.name: PCI DSS - Protect Cardholder Data
features.description: Never store sensitive authentication data (CVV2, full magnetic stripe, PIN) after authorization, minimize cardholder data storage, render PAN unreadable through tokenization/hashing/encryption, use strong cryptography (AES-256), encrypt transmission using TLS 1.2+, implement key management, rotate keys annually
features.stakeholderBenefit: Payment information is encrypted and protected so financial data cannot be stolen or misused

features.name: PCI DSS - Vulnerability Management
features.description: Use and regularly update anti-virus software, develop secure systems following secure coding practices, implement vulnerability management program, conduct quarterly vulnerability scans by ASV, achieve passing scan results, conduct internal scans quarterly, apply critical patches within one month, conduct annual penetration testing
features.stakeholderBenefit: Secure systems and applications prevent vulnerabilities from being exploited to access payment data

features.name: PCI DSS - Access Control
features.description: Restrict access to cardholder data to only those with business need-to-know, assign unique ID to each person, implement multi-factor authentication for remote access and administrative access, restrict physical access, maintain visitor log, implement role-based access controls, review access rights every six months
features.stakeholderBenefit: Access to cardholder data is restricted based on business need-to-know, minimizing exposure

features.name: PCI DSS - Monitor and Test Networks
features.description: Track and monitor all access to network resources and cardholder data, implement automated audit trails, log user ID/event type/date/time/success/failure, synchronize clocks using NTP, secure audit trails, review logs daily, retain audit history for one year, implement intrusion detection/prevention, conduct file integrity monitoring
features.stakeholderBenefit: Monitoring all access to payment systems enables detection and response to security incidents

features.name: PCI DSS - Information Security Policy
features.description: Maintain information security policy addressing all PCI DSS requirements, review policy annually, communicate policy to all personnel, provide security awareness training upon hire and annually, implement formal security awareness programs, establish incident response plan, test plan annually, designate security management personnel
features.stakeholderBenefit: Clear security policies and training ensure employees understand responsibilities for protecting payment data

features.name: Tokenization Implementation
features.description: Integrate with PCI-compliant payment gateway providing tokenization, transmit payment data directly to gateway without touching platform servers, receive and store only non-sensitive tokens, use tokens for subsequent transactions, implement client-side encryption, validate tokens cannot be reverse-engineered, implement token lifecycle management
features.stakeholderBenefit: Tokenization avoids storing actual card numbers, reducing PCI compliance scope and security risks

features.name: Hosted Payment Pages
features.description: Redirect users to payment gateway's secure page for payment information entry, never receive or process actual cardholder data, receive only transaction results and tokens, implement seamless user experience with consistent branding, validate hosted pages use TLS 1.2+, handle redirects securely
features.stakeholderBenefit: Users enter payment information on secure page protected by payment gateway's security

features.name: Data Encryption in Transit
features.description: Use TLS 1.2+ for all transmission of cardholder data, disable older insecure protocols (SSL 2.0, SSL 3.0, TLS 1.0, TLS 1.1), implement perfect forward secrecy (ECDHE), use strong cipher suites (AES-256-GCM), obtain certificates from trusted CAs, implement certificate pinning for mobile apps, auto-renew certificates, redirect HTTP to HTTPS
features.stakeholderBenefit: Payment information is encrypted during transmission so it cannot be intercepted by attackers

features.name: Data Encryption at Rest
features.description: Encrypt stored cardholder data using AES-256 or equivalent, store encryption keys separately from encrypted data, use key management service (AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault, HashiCorp Vault), implement key rotation annually, encrypt database backups, encrypt file storage, implement cryptographic erasure for secure deletion
features.stakeholderBenefit: Payment-related data encrypted at rest remains protected even if storage media is compromised

features.name: Cryptocurrency Security
features.description: Never store private keys on platform servers, use payment gateway services for cryptocurrency custody, implement multi-signature wallets for any held cryptocurrency, conduct blockchain transaction verification, implement fraud detection for crypto transactions, comply with crypto-specific regulations, maintain audit trails
features.stakeholderBenefit: Platform securely handles cryptocurrency payments, protecting against theft and fraud

features.name: Quarterly Vulnerability Scans
features.description: Conduct quarterly vulnerability scans by Approved Scanning Vendor (ASV), scan all external-facing systems storing/processing/transmitting cardholder data, achieve passing scan results (no vulnerabilities rated 4.0+ on CVSS), conduct rescans after remediation, conduct scans after network changes, maintain documentation
features.stakeholderBenefit: Quarterly vulnerability scans identify and remediate security weaknesses

features.name: Data Protection and Privacy
features.description: Comprehensive data protection with TLS 1.3+ encryption in transit, AES-256 at rest, GDPR/CCPA compliance, biometric data safeguards, and role-based access control
